title: Bangladesh Army Recruitment 2026: Officer & Soldier Guide
metaDescription: Bangladesh Army recruitment 2026: BMA Long Course age 16.5-21, GPA rules, soldier trades, ISSB selection and how to apply online at join.army.mil.bd.
headline: Bangladesh Army Recruitment 2026: How to Join

sections.title: BMA Long Course: becoming an officer
sections.content:
The main officer route is the Bangladesh Military Academy (BMA) Long Course, which runs twice a year. The 97th BMA Long Course invited applications until 14 March 2026, while the 98th BMA Long Course opened on 29 July 2026 with applications closing on 17 October 2026 and the written examination held on 15 November 2026.

Officer cadets must be Bangladeshi citizens by birth, unmarried, and aged 16 years 6 months to 21 years on 1 January or 1 July of the joining year; serving armed forces personnel may apply at 18 to 23 years. The minimum height is 5 feet 4 inches for men and 5 feet 1 inch for women, with minimum weights of 54 kg and 46 kg.

sections.title: Education and physical standards for officers
sections.content:
For the national medium, candidates need GPA 5.00 in either SSC or HSC and at least GPA 4.50 in the other. English-medium candidates need at least three A grades and three B grades in six O-level subjects plus two B grades in two A-level subjects, or an equivalent combination. Serving personnel need GPA 4.00 separately in both SSC and HSC.

Applications are made online at join.army.mil.bd, with a non-refundable fee of BDT 2,000, paid as BDT 1,000 through mobile banking such as bKash, Rocket or Teletalk and BDT 1,000 as the online registration fee. Age affidavits are not accepted, and divorced, widowed or separated candidates are ineligible.

sections.title: Soldier recruitment: General and Technical trades
sections.content:
Soldiers are recruited through separate circulars, with General Trade (GD) and Technical Trade (TT) as the main categories. GD candidates need at least GPA 3.00 in SSC or equivalent and must be aged 17 to 22 years, while TT candidates need SSC Science with GPA 3.00 plus a minimum three-month technical trade course approved by the Bangladesh Technical Education Board, with an age limit of 17 to 23 years.

Soldier applications also run online, through sainik.teletalk.com.bd, and candidates must be unmarried Bangladeshi citizens. Outstanding soldiers can later apply for commissioned officer posts through internal selection, including the in-service GL Commission route for experienced JCOs and NCOs.

sections.title: Selection: written test, medical and ISSB
sections.content:
Officer selection runs in three stages. Candidates first face a primary selection of health and oral examinations at various cantonments, then a written examination covering the subjects set out in the circular. Those who qualify appear before the Inter-Services Selection Board (ISSB) at Dhaka Cantonment for the final assessment of leadership, intelligence and personality.

Final merit lists decide who joins the BMA for training. Cadets who complete the long course are commissioned as officers in the Bangladesh Army, with careers spanning infantry, artillery, engineers, signals, medical and other corps, and promotion following service, courses and performance.

faqs.q: What is the age limit for Bangladesh Army officer entry?
faqs.a: For the BMA Long Course, candidates must be 16 years 6 months to 21 years old on 1 January or 1 July of the joining year. Serving members of the Bangladesh Armed Forces may apply at 18 to 23 years. Soldier posts have different limits: 17 to 22 years for General Trade and 17 to 23 years for Technical Trade.

faqs.q: What GPA do I need for the BMA Long Course?
faqs.a: National-medium candidates need GPA 5.00 in either SSC or HSC and at least GPA 4.50 in the other examination. English-medium candidates need at least three A grades and three B grades across six O-level subjects plus two B grades in two A-level subjects, or an equivalent combination. Serving personnel need GPA 4.00 separately in SSC and HSC.

faqs.q: How do I apply for Bangladesh Army recruitment 2026?
faqs.a: Apply online at join.army.mil.bd for officer courses and through sainik.teletalk.com.bd for soldier posts. The officer application fee is BDT 2,000 in total, split between BDT 1,000 paid by mobile banking and BDT 1,000 as the online registration fee. Always check the official circular for the exact dates, because deadlines change with each course.

faqs.q: What happens at the ISSB test in Bangladesh?
faqs.a: Candidates who pass the written examination appear before the Inter-Services Selection Board at Dhaka Cantonment. The ISSB assesses intelligence, leadership, teamwork and personality through written tests, group tasks, interviews and outdoor exercises over several days. Only candidates who clear the ISSB make the final merit list for BMA training.
